title: South Maui Community Plan review
summary: On October 21 the committee took up Bill 139, which would add 85.57 acres in North Kīhei to the urban growth boundary, alongside Bill 108, the South Maui Community Plan. It passed 8 to 0 an amended action to study a new South Maui to Central Maui road that could serve as an evacuation route. Plan review continues November 18, and a draft is due December 2 for the next council.

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members voted eight to zero to encourage restoring existing government trails and historical roads where practicable.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A motion would require low-impact development, green infrastructure or permaculture design in South Maui developments to reduce stormwater runoff.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The amended flood policy passed with six ayes, one no and two members excused.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A motion asked that Policy 2.4.2 put traditional Hawaiian practices and nature-based solutions first to manage flooding.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A community advisory member said South Maui residents opposed an earlier concrete drainage plan that sent runoff into the ocean, out of concern for coral reefs.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A Water Department official said the department supports protecting water rights for owners who move back from the shoreline.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The draft South Maui vision statement calls for affordable housing close to good jobs.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Amend policy 2.3.25 on wastewater injection wells: The committee voted 6–0 to move toward eliminating wastewater injection wells in South Maui.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A county official said injection wells cannot be eliminated now because state health rules require 100% backup.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members voted 6–0 to require gray or recycled water in county parks and gardens when available and legally permissible.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Amend policy 2.3.22 so new developments, including affordable housing, connect to recycled water systems when available: A motion was moved and seconded, but the captions do not record a vote.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Amend policy 2.3.20 on catchment systems and gray water for non-potable use: The committee voted 6–0 to support catchment and gray water where allowed by the State Department of Health.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Amend policy 2.3.18 so development must follow the public trust doctrine and the state water code: The motion passed with six ayes; the captions garble the "no" count.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Delete policy 2.3.13: The committee voted 7–0 to delete the policy because it nearly matches action 3.14.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A deputy corporation counsel may draft policy language on pre-authorization during emergencies.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Replace policy 2.3.10 with the recommended changes on Attachment 3A, page 50: The committee voted 7–0 to use the recommended wording, which adds a county department to the consultation list.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair suggested a member could propose a goal 2.5 policy on moving natural resources out of a moku with consultation.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Amend policy 2.3.3 to the recommended language: The amendment passed 7–0, with two members excused.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: One testifier asked for 150-foot buffers around gulches.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members began reviewing plan Sections 2.3 and 2.4.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Planning staff said water neutrality means no net depletion of freshwater resources.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The planning director said a new hotel starts from zero water use, so it could not truly be net zero.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The Planning Commission added the words "to the extent practicable" to the advisory committee's hotel water policy.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The draft plan asks new hotels and hotel expansions to be water neutral "to the extent practicable."
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Motion to restore a deleted policy allowing no further development unless infrastructure is in place: The roll call ended at four ayes, one no and four excused, and the captions do not state whether it passed.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A council member said any small storm can close South Kīhei Road, leaving one way in and out.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair raised restoring a deleted policy allowing no further development unless needed infrastructure is in place.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members added "to the extent permitted by law" to a housing preference policy.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair plans to wait on Section 3 decisions until pending responses come back, which would be next term.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The new policy encourages housing projects of 10 units or more to present to a nearby community association before applying to the County.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The planning director warned that a requirement a project cannot meet could stop an affordable housing project in the special management area.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members voted 7–0 to require pedestrian-oriented new developments, with mixed uses required "to the extent practicable."
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A council member said the Kīhei community spoke strongly about emergency evacuations, citing the Lahaina Fire.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The advisory committee chair said connecting cul-de-sacs matters for people's lives after the fires.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members agreed to judge repeated policies case by case and mark kept ones with an asterisk.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A council member asked whether the county could work with the state to map a bypass route early.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair said testimony showed fear that Kīhei has no safe, fast way out in emergencies.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Members voted 5–1 to reword a policy so it names affordable and workforce housing projects instead of code sections.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Policy 2.1.1: add reference to implementing actions 1.05A and 1.05B: A motion to note that policy 2.1.1 ties to actions 1.05A and B was made and seconded; the captions do not record the vote result.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: Main motion: recommend passage of Bill 108-2026 on first reading: A main motion to recommend passage of Bill 108 on first reading was made and seconded; no vote was taken on it today.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair said changes to this plan can be made with five votes.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: A testifier said this review process is too rushed.
timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

timeline.text: The chair deferred the bill with no objections, keeping it for later meetings.

timeline.body: County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
